Name: Jiji Cat Recolor (Ghibli) (CP)
Author: LorSnore
Description:
[size=2]A recolor of the cat pet to look like Jiji from Kiki's Delivery Service[/size]


[size=3]- [b]Requires [u][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/u] and [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/u][/b]
- [b]Loads the entire cat.xnb spritesheet[/b] and [b]partially edits Cursors.xnb[/b] for the cat head shown in the menu (meaning it can't be used with other cat pet replacement mods/cat.xnb replacements, but this change can be [b]easily undone [/b]by removing it from your Mods folder)
- [b]Install[/b] by downloading, [b]unzipping, [/b]and dragging the [b]unzipped[/b] folder to your Mods folder, the same one where you installed Content Patcher
[/size]
